rationale: 20 courses / 86 lessons, built on the winning design's spine — backwards from three concrete two-week outcomes (EVERYDAY: asks well, attaches documents, steers depth, handles the shield dialog, finds last Tuesday's chat, has delegated one recurring job; BUILDER: a published agent grounded on a knowledge base, one active routine with a form and a table behind it, and the ability to read a failed run; ADMIN: roles, groups, an integration policy, a shield posture, an encryption decision and a cost cap they understand), with chapters as milestones on those journeys rather than feature tours. Pacing psychology is unchanged: everyday learners get one control per chapter and an early win; builders get the 'what breaks' chapter before the 'ship it' chapter; admins get decision-first chapters that open with the decision and its default and close on a rollout or verification step. GRAFTED FROM THE OTHER DESIGNS. (1) Design 1's implementability discipline: every single `action` step now names a check id AND the list endpoint plus predicate that satisfies it (e.g. 'check: kb-linked — GET /api/kb/:id/usage returns an agent row'); the five existing checks (agent-created, automation-first, kb-with-doc, cowork-first, hive-master) are reused, and any step that could not be verified against a real endpoint was demoted to an exercise or a slide rather than dressed up as an action — that removes the ~22 unverifiable 'open a screen and notice something' actions the judges flagged. (2) Design 1's step-palette teaching, as routine-steps-that-persist: update/delete needing a condition, a knowledge write with no source reference producing ninety documents, a whole-object binding in a notification as an egress event, private addresses blocked on web-service calls, the code step's two independent gates. (3) Design 1's two missing everyday chapters, closing the coverage holes all three judges named: settings-preferences (Simple Mode, the forced 768px rule, startup screen, desktop-only tabs) and learning-center-tour (mastery, the review queue built from mistakes plus lessons older than fourteen days, practice, the tutor's hint-first rule, the four-attempt soft gate). Design 1's habit of teaching known gaps as gaps is adopted throughout: forms are signed-in and organisation-only in this build, the webpages describe-to-build bar is inert, More frameworks and Data portability are placeholders. (4) Design 1/2's split of approvals into deciding before designing, because most learners meet an approval as a decider long before they author one. (5) Design 2's honest time budgets (8–13 minutes for 9–12 steps, so a lesson carrying an AI-graded exercise is not sold as six minutes), its rule that every chapter closes on a verified action or a diagnose-the-failure step, its situation-shaped quizzes with a wrong-looking-right option, and its read-only stance on auditor-facing registers. (6) Design 2's contiguous, single-page opening tour in getting-started. WEAKNESSES FIXED. Nothing is retired: RETIRED LESSON IDS = NONE — all 25 existing lesson ids are kept and deepened in place, all 9 existing course ids survive, and all 9 existing badge ids stay on the course they were earned from. course-skills-automation remains the Skills course and keeps badge-automator (retitled 'Method Maker' so it does not collide with 'Prompt Smith'), so no learner's badge moves course and no course-row progress is orphaned; course-routines-production gets a new badge-operator instead. course-power keeps badge-connector and connecting-integrations but moves to the EVERYDAY path as a personal workspace course (preferences, connections and lending, borrowing colleagues' agents, how the Academy works), because the personal half of the ceiling→grant→connection ladder was mis-pathed under admin; the org half moves into course-admin-essentials as integrations-org-access, which also covers the estate surfaces that were missing entirely (n8n, Google Maps, MCP installs, GitHub Sync, Nextcloud's enable-wins per-group disable list). Research Swarm and the Hive Mind now have their own gated chapter; the chat agent store and session skills have one too. course-hive-master is LAST in the catalog with its single hive-master lesson, and hive-master now teaches what to do when a criterion stays red. Gate corrections: org-usage is gated on org_admin (canSeeOrg is org-admin only, not manage_users); the grounded-chat lesson is left ungated but explicitly teaches that the Knowledge pill needs admin rights, 'all', or the knowledge-bases beta, and its action accepts grounding OR an attachment so a plain member can never dead-end (knowledge_bases_beta is deliberately NOT used as gate.feature, since that field resolves against licence features); datatables-create stays on `automations` alone (personal tables skip manage_datatables) while columns and sharing add it; the Enterprise automation_sharing boundary is taught as a slide inside datatables-share-and-retain rather than used as a gate, so retention is not hidden behind a capability it does not need; shield-org-evidence and usage-caps carry advanced_usage_monitoring. Compliance never rehearses into the evidence chain: the hands-on steps are genuine configuration acts (breach recipients, a reviewed and downloaded ROPA, completing onboarding), not fake DSRs or test incidents. The skill-create tour anchor is used again in creating-skills (it is live in SkillsGrid.jsx); flow-build sims appear only in routine lessons; every lesson carries at least three interactions and at least three kinds, and no lesson falls below eight outline entries. Webpages get two chapters instead of one, inside course-apps. STRUCTURE. Tracks stay small so certificates remain attainable: foundations = Foundations, Prompt Engineering, Personal Data Safely (cert-foundations); builder = Build Your First Agent, Knowledge Bases That Answer, Skills (cert-builder); the other fourteen ride track power so cert-practitioner (any four) stays the broad one. Paths: everyday 7 courses, builder 9 (including the capstone), admin 4. Prereqs are used five times only, never more than one per course and acyclic: build-agent←foundations, skills←build-agent, routines-production←automations-mastery, apps←data-and-forms, hive-master←automations-mastery.
